_about: Reference values and expected interpretations. Cell values were read directly from the published PSI CSV text and expected normalized values were computed by hand from the stated factor. Semantic, matching, coverage and adversarial cases state the expected interpretation, the exact source location and the acceptance criterion. Verification source: PSI experiment tables and PSI investigation metadata only; the underlying publications, figures and PDFs were NOT consulted. Prepared by the PyroLens developers (AI-assisted); no external combustion specialist has reviewed it. Reviewer status for every case: PENDING INDEPENDENT DOMAIN-EXPERT REVIEW.

known_issues_for_expert_review.detail: Sample Length (cm)=40.6 and Sample Width (cm)=94 while PSI-100 (same SAFFIRE hardware family) lists length 94 cm and width 40.6 cm: columns may be swapped in the source. Kept as published.

'CO initial ambient composition' — FLEX objective mentions CO2 as a tested suppressant and a FLEX publication title mentions 'carbon dioxide enriched environments'; this is circumstantial and the column is left ambiguous.
Air Rate values -0.28 and -5.92 cm/s: physical meaning (direction, sensor offset) not stated.
Calibrated final O2 values as low as 0.6 % and as high as 40.4 % are kept as published; their test context was not verified.
Classified as smoke-generation (not flame) rows and excluded from combustion coverage; PSI-102 metadata calls runs 'combustion events'. Provisional; requires expert review.
Diluent recorded from the source term 'Air' (column header); composition not tabulated. Matching against N2 is capped at partial.
Comparison tolerances, diluent tolerance (0.05/0.10 mole fraction), coverage thresholds and flow-configuration compatibility rules are provisional engineering choices.
